rationale: No supported optimization has all preconditions met for this workflow. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) is contraindicated: the build matrix produces arm64 and x86_64 native binaries, so every matrix outcome is required and full failure diagnostics are needed; the workflow already sets fail-fast: false appropriately. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) requires representative successful-duration history, but the repository CI history is explicitly "not_a_measured_baseline" / "historical_context_only", so an informed timeout cannot be set without risking valid slow macOS builds exceeding the limit. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) has no applicable lockfile/dependency manifest to key a cache on; the workflow installs system tools via brew and uses system clang/make rather than a cached package ecosystem. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs) could affect required-check status, and required checks are listed as "not_verified", so preserving them cannot be confirmed. Applying any of these would either weaken coverage or rest on unverified prerequisites.
